payout_quote: accounts will receive a contribution from the state, called 'Earnings Enhancements,' to match a percentage of their annual deposits, ranging from 14 percent to two percent determined by the account owner's prior year federal adjusted gross income
steps: Open a START account online at startsaving.la.gov (first deposit of at least $10 within 180 days of approval).
Make deposits during the calendar year.
Use the account for qualified higher education expenses.
catches: A percentage of YOUR deposits, not a flat bonus: deposit $0, get $0; the top 14% rate requires prior-year federal AGI under $30,000.
The account owner or the beneficiary must be a Louisiana resident when the account is opened.

All Earnings Enhancements and interest thereon are forfeited on rollover to another state's 529 plan; voluntary termination keeps all EEs with START, and accounts open under 12 months earn no interest.
Deposits are deductible from Louisiana taxable income up to $2,400 per year per account ($4,800 married filing jointly), with carryforward of unused amounts.

Non-qualified withdrawals: earnings taxed federally and by the state plus a 10% federal penalty on earnings; previously deducted contributions are recaptured into Louisiana income - consult a tax advisor.
biggest_catch: The 'match' is 2%-14% of your own annual deposits based on income - and every dollar of Earnings Enhancement is forfeited if you ever roll the account to another state's 529 plan.
eligibility: Account owner or designated beneficiary must be a Louisiana resident at account opening; individuals, legal entities, and custodians may open.
timing: Ongoing annual program: deposits during the calendar year earn the enhancement tier set by the prior year's federal AGI.
payout_value_note: Percentage-based match: 2%-14% of annual deposits by prior-year AGI; no dollar cap stated in official terms.
numeric_basis: payout from official terms (2%-14% of deposits, no dollar cap); time: online account opening, est. 15-30 min active.
